subject: Information Theory
title: Viral Spreading
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Viral Spreading.

hook.text: Gangnam Style reached one billion YouTube views in 2012. It spread like a disease—infecting person after person.

buildup.text: Viral content follows epidemic models: R₀ is the reproduction number. If R₀ > 1, the content spreads exponentially.

discovery.text: Network structure matters: content reaching a hub node spreads faster than starting from a peripheral node.

twist.text: Most content that could go viral doesn't. Virality requires the right content, right network position, and timing.

climax.text: Information epidemiology uses the same math as disease modeling. Spreading information and disease are isomorphic.

punchline.text: R₀ above one: it goes viral. Below one: it dies. Threshold is everything.

quiz.question: What determines whether content goes viral?
options: Whether the reproduction number R₀ exceeds 1 in the network
